title: ChatGPT gives free users unlimited GPT-5.6 Luna text chats
friendlyTitle: Free ChatGPT users get unlimited text chats
summary: OpenAI is making GPT-5.6 Luna the default for Free and Go users, with unlimited text chats and a Think button for harder questions. Plus and Pro users get a more focused GPT-5.6 Sol and a slider for controlling reasoning effort.
friendlySummary: OpenAI is giving free users unlimited text chats with GPT-5.6 Luna. Paid users also get better answer controls.
whyItMatters: The useful baseline for free AI rises sharply: long-running text help becomes easier to access without watching a message counter. Tool use, files and images still have limits, so “unlimited” applies specifically to text chats.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can use ChatGPT for longer writing, learning and planning sessions without running out of text messages. Files and images still have limits.
